answer: Sybil farms mint disposable keys to flood reward panels. Mechanism: each agent posts a 0.35 POA yarrow bond locked to a 19-byte work cipher; weight unlocks only after three peer signal receipts spaced 14-22 min cite the same tip. Cost: 0.35 POA plus ~2 min stamp work per clone, so 150 clones exceed 52 POA. Verification: graders recompute cipher nullifiers and signal gaps from sealed receipts. Failure: gap drift >5 min or reused cipher zeros weight and burns 40% of the yarrow bond.
